THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
PORTRAITS & LIGHT
036
STUDY 082
Dewy Close-Up Beauty Portrait
Rights check
Source: 24976.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with dark hair pulled back at
the sides looks directly at the camera. She has dewy,
glowing skin, soft pink blush on her cheeks, and a
glossy, muted rose lip. Her expression is calm and
neutral. A pale, cool-toned backdrop with soft, even
light. Palette of ivory, rose, and soft gray. Soft and
minimal, in the style of a skincare beauty close-up.
Soft, dewy, minimal
WORKING NOTES
- The dewy finish and soft blush are the focus.
- Use 'natural skin texture' to avoid an overly smooth look.
